primitives.name: API Rate Limiting Constraint
primitives.verbatim_quote: NVIDIA staff on the dev forums say trial usage is rate-limit-governed, community baseline **~40 RPM per key** (per-model, traffic-dependent); older docs mention 1,000–5,000 signup credits but the current scheme is rate-limit, not credit-metered.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'RPM': 'Requests Per Minute, dimensionless', 'key': 'API authentication token, dimensionless'}
primitives.assumptions: Usage is bounded by fixed-rate limits; no credit-based metering exists.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Exceeding 40 RPM per key results in throttling or denial of service.

layer2.mapping: API rate limits mirror computational resource constraints in GSE's distributed job scheduling.
layer2.telemetry: Observed request success/failure ratio over time windows.

primitives.name: Checkpointed Session Memory
primitives.verbatim_quote: checkpoint diary per job means a resumed session picks up where the last died.
primitives.assumptions: Session state persists across interruptions; resume logic is deterministic.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Loss of diary file leads to full restart of job execution.

layer2.mapping: Enables GSE to recover from transient failures without re-execution.
layer2.telemetry: Time-to-resume vs. total job duration metrics.
